description: Somos un equipo de desarrolladores de software, apasionados por las soluciones a través del software y aplicativos web.
summary: AstroHealth Companion is an offline-capable health-monitoring app for astronauts. It tracks key health indicators, highlights potential concerns, and provides environment-specific recommendations to support crew well-being during space missions.
details:
AstroHealth Companion is a web-based health-monitoring tool designed for astronauts and future missions. It lets crew members record heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, sleep, glucose, and fatigue. The system evaluates each measurement using configurable health thresholds for different environments, including spacecraft and lunar bases, and combines the results to show an overall status. A dashboard presents trends, alerts, and clear, prioritized recommendations so users can notice potential concerns and take informed action. The app supports health awareness and decision-making; it is not a substitute for professional medical care.

Our final proposal is an accessible, environment-aware companion that helps astronauts monitor their well-being even when mission conditions make regular support or connectivity difficult. Measurements can be entered without specialized hardware. When the connection is unavailable, the app can save data locally and sync it later. We built the frontend with React, TypeScript, and Vite, and the backend with Python and FastAPI, using a database for records. The project’s creative element is combining mission-specific evaluation with an easy-to-read visual dashboard and actionable guidance. Our design considers limited connectivity, quick access to information, and reducing the effort needed to understand health trends.
